sources.title: Hamilton Lane press release — KAIO tokenizes Hamilton Lane private credit fund on Sei
sources.excerpt: Dated 2025-10-15, issued by the fund manager. Access vehicle is the HL SCOPE Private Credit Access fund, a feeder into SCOPE that is not managed or operated by Hamilton Lane. Institutional and accredited investors only. KAIO says >$200M of fund assets tokenised; offered through a regulated fund manager. Quotes Olivier Dang (KAIO COO) and Victor Jung (Hamilton Lane).

sources.title: Aave blog — Aave Horizon launches
sources.excerpt: Published 2025-08-26. KAIO (formerly Libre) is named in Horizon's institutional network. Launch collateral comes from Superstate (USTB, USCC) and Centrifuge (JTRSY, JAAA), with Circle USYC to follow; no KAIO asset is listed as collateral. NAVs via Chainlink SmartData/NAVLink.

sources.title: Dubai VARA — Regulatory, enforcement and warning notices
sources.published: list page; only notices dated on or before 2026-05-06 considered
sources.excerpt: Enforcement notices and consumer/marketplace alerts from Nov 2022 onward. None names KAIO, Libre, LibreCo, Laser Digital or WebN. Later entries about other firms ignored.

sources.title: Sei blog — BlackRock and Brevan Howard tokenized funds launch on Sei via KAIO
sources.excerpt: Published 2025-10-08 (page modified 2026-02-25). The KAIO token holds shares in the BlackRock ICS USD Liquidity Fund; these tokenised shares are issued only by KAIO and are not sponsored or approved by BlackRock. Brevan Howard Master Fund access also launches. Institutional and accredited investors only; >$200M tokenised on KAIO.

active_enforcement_action.note: no enforcement or alert against KAIO/Libre on VARA's list up to 6 May 2026, and none reported in 2024–26 coverage (KAIO-08, KAIO-11, KAIO-13, KAIO-14). ADGM FSRA, MAS, SEC and court records were NOT checked directly.
